sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Puzzle Parking 3D are centered around guiding multiple cars into a parking space without any collisions or touching. Players use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to control the movement of the cars, using a combination of speed, acceleration, and braking to navigate the cars through the levels. The game features a variety of cars, each with its unique size, speed, and acceleration, which adds an extra layer of complexity to the gameplay.

As players progress through the levels, the difficulty increases, and new challenges are introduced, such as obstacles, narrow parking spaces, and limited time. The game requires players to think strategically, anticipating the movement of the cars and planning their route in advance. Players must also take into account the limited space, obstacles, and the cars' size and speed to avoid collisions and efficiently park the cars.

The game features a variety of level types, each with its unique challenges and objectives. Some levels may require players to park a specific number of cars within a limited time, while others may require players to park cars in a specific order or within a specific space.
